description:
Create a time-limited quote: the fixed 25.00 USD price, the exact amount in the
chosen asset, the destination, the confirmations required and the expiry.

controller_network.description: The wallet's network, e.g. eip155:8453 for Base (the default)
controller_network.title: Controller Network

controller_public_key.description: Ed25519 public key that will control the DID-LLM: ed25519:z6Mk..., or ed25519: followed by 64 hex characters or base64. Give this, a wallet, or both.
controller_public_key.title: Controller Public Key

controller_wallet_address.description: EVM wallet that will control the DID-LLM: 0x... (checksummed or all lower case) or eip155:<chain id>:0x.... Its control is proven like the key's, by signing a challenge (smart wallets included).
controller_wallet_address.title: Controller Wallet Address

idempotency_key.description: Optional random key (16-128 characters, e.g. a UUID); retrying with the same key returns the same quote
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

metadata.description: Optional small key/value metadata (up to 20 keys)
metadata.title: Metadata

preferred_payment_option.description: Payment option ID from the offer, e.g. dmd_pow_native
preferred_payment_option.title: Preferred Payment Option

name: debitmydata_create_did_payment_quote
title: Create a DID-LLM payment quote
